title: Cults - STL de reparation de console centrale 964/993
notes: La fiche Cults expose deux fichiers STL gratuits pour reparer une console 964/993 et affiche les bboxes de fichier suivantes : 27 x 63,67898 x 5,5 mm et 33,237728 x 61,999001 x 5,580281 mm. La description mentionne une publication Thingiverse en 2021 et un auteur identifie, mais le champ de licence Cults n'est pas renseigne. Le telechargement et la redistribution restent donc suspendus jusqu'a confirmation des droits; les bboxes ne sont pas des cotes d'interface et le mesh n'a pas ete copie dans le depot. 2026-10-15: the Cults page was not read: cults3d.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403), so permission for automated agents could not be established and the page was not requested. The description recorded on 2026-08-29 says the model was first published on Thingiverse in 2021, but no thing number was recorded, so that original could not be looked up. The 63.679 x 5.5 mm extents of the first file coincide with the 67.000 x 63.678 x 5.500 mm envelope declared for SRC-RENN3D-CONSOLE-SWITCH-TAB-REPAIR (author 9khil); a common design is possible but not established, and the two records name different authors. The 'game' segment in the Cults URL is a marketplace category, not evidence of a game asset. Licence and redistribution remain unknown.
